address: Palmengartenstraße 11, Frankfurt on the Main, 60325, Germany
bio: Andreas Krolik has been synonymous with fantastic vegan cuisine for years. Here in the Palmenhaus, adjacent to the Palmengarten, the chef creatively combines top-notch ingredients by virtue of extremely precise craftsmanship. His style is modern, yet rooted in classic culinary tradition. For example, the happy marriage of John Dory and Norwegian scallops, with a nutty macadamia crunch, sweet and sour pointed cabbage, firm pumpkin and the exotic touch of a curry-lemongrass sauce, is delicious. In the evening, two set menus are served: Grands Produits with meat and fish, and Ethical Vegan Cuisine a testament to the chef's passion for plant-based cuisine.
